title: Auditing Proprietary Alignment in Large Language Models: A Comparative Framework Without a Ground-Truth Standard

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring systematic deviations in model responses to sensitive political topics (e.g., China-related political issues and U.S. political topics) compared to a reference set of baseline models using semantic embedding distances and rubric-based LLM scoring.

Detecting provider-specific alignment by quantifying relative behavioral divergence in responses to topics concerning the model provider (e.g., Meta-related sensitive topics) against a diverse ensemble of baseline models.

Analyzing deviations in how models handle culturally and historically sensitive topics (e.g., Chinese Cultural Revolutions) through comparative behavioral analysis and statistical testing against other language models.

Evaluating model responses to sensitive religious movements within specific geopolitical contexts (e.g., China-sensitive religious topics) using a comparative framework to identify unique alignment constraints.
